completed_items: P081 boundary matrix docs/fixture validator and embedded fixture are wired through the canonical proposal gate.
BoundaryPolicy is injected into daemon GraphQL and MCP construction; denied known MCP tools use -32004 while unknown tools remain -32601.
Audit log/checkpoint storage, caller_class, approval idempotency, MCP idempotency, and command-journal idempotency migrations/repositories are present.
GraphQL boundaryRuntime and operatorAlerts expose bounded runtime/alert readback without raw audit rows.
MCP runtime.health and operator.alerts.list expose the same bounded diagnostic surface and remain readable in read_only_safe_mode.
Safe mode denies GraphQL mutations and state-changing MCP tools while permitting bounded diagnostic reads.
principals.json loading rejects hard links and non-private parent directories; bootstrap creates the auth directory with 0700 mode on Unix.
Swift P081ApprovalActionAttemptStore owns approval idempotency keys across retries/restarts.
Swift GraphQL response decoding preserves typed extensions.redactions and maps ordinary nil, redacted nil, and drop_resource to distinct accessibility states.
Swift NotificationService applies P081 operator alert native-delivery lifecycle, including Dock/attention contribution dedupe and clear semantics.
GraphQL WebSocket pre-auth closes with 4401/4403/4408 for unauthorized, forbidden caller, and missing/malformed init paths.
MCP state-changing command idempotency is linked to command_journal before replayable success.
P081 operator readback fixture and boundary-policy shadow coverage report are concrete, non-placeholder evidence and are validated by proposal-081.
deferred_items: Live production shadow observation accumulation remains rollout evidence; same-tree canary coverage is recorded for all matrix rows.
